ai: Driving through the storm without lights was sheer lunacy.

immemorial.zh: 太古的；久遠到無法追憶的

freed.zh: 釋放；使自由（free 的過去式）

牧師在門口迎接每一位會眾。
The old farm lies yonder, beyond those hills.
那座老農場就在那邊，山丘的另一頭。
Look at the lights shining yonder across the valley.
看那邊山谷對面閃爍的燈光。
He pointed to yonder mountain and said we would camp there.
他指著那邊的山，說我們要在那裡露營。
Do you see the tree on yonder hill?
你看到那邊山丘上的樹嗎？
She wore her hair in a long plait down her back.
她把頭髮編成一條長辮子垂在背後。
The little girl asked her mother for a plait.
小女孩請媽媽幫她編辮子。
Can you plait my hair before the party?
你可以在派對前幫我編頭髮嗎？
They plait straw into baskets by hand.
他們用手把稻草編成籃子。
The kids spent the rainy afternoon in the playroom.
孩子們在遊戲室度過下雨的午後。
There are lots of toys and books in the playroom.
遊戲室裡有許多玩具和書。
The numbering of the pages stopped after page ten.
頁碼編到第十頁就中斷了。
A clear numbering system helps us find files faster.
清楚的編號系統能幫我們更快找到檔案。

barnyard.zh: 穀倉旁的場地；農家庭院
ai: Chickens ran freely around the barnyard.
雞在農家庭院裡自由跑動。
The farmer crossed the barnyard to feed the pigs.
農夫穿過庭院去餵豬。
We bought an upholstered chair for the living room.
我們為客廳買了一張有軟墊的椅子。
The restaurant has comfortable upholstered seats.
這家餐廳有舒適的軟墊座椅。
Memorization alone will not help you understand the subject.
光靠死背無法讓你理解這門學科。
The teacher gave us tips for the memorization of new words.
老師教我們背新單字的訣竅。
We ordered fried haddock with chips.
我們點了炸黑線鱈配薯條。
Haddock is a popular white fish in many countries.
黑線鱈在許多國家是很受歡迎的白肉魚。
The rocket used up most of its propellant in the first minutes.
火箭在最初幾分鐘就用掉了大部分推進劑。
The spray can contains a gas propellant.
這罐噴霧含有氣體推進劑。
She felt a constriction in her chest when she ran.
她跑步時感到胸口一陣緊縮。
Cold weather can cause the constriction of blood vessels.
寒冷的天氣會造成血管收縮。
He is myopic and cannot read signs without glasses.
他近視，沒戴眼鏡就看不清標示。
Cutting the training budget was a myopic decision.
砍掉訓練預算是個短視的決定。
The bricklayer built a neat wall around the garden.
砌磚工人在花園周圍砌了一道整齊的牆。
My uncle worked as a bricklayer for thirty years.
我叔叔當了三十年的砌磚工人。
Factional fights slowed the work of the committee.
派系鬥爭拖慢了委員會的工作。
The party is weak because of its factional divisions.
這個政黨因為派系分裂而變得脆弱。
He is tying his shoelaces before the race.
他在比賽前綁鞋帶。
She spent an hour tying ribbons on the gift boxes.
她花了一小時在禮盒上綁緞帶。

potluck.zh: 百樂餐（每人各帶一道菜的聚餐）
ai: Everyone brought a dish to the office potluck.
每個人都帶了一道菜來參加辦公室的百樂餐。
We are having a potluck in the park on Saturday.
我們星期六要在公園辦百樂餐。
The priest prayed to sanctify the new church.
神父祈禱使這座新教堂成為聖所。
Some people believe that marriage should be sanctified by faith.
有些人認為婚姻應當由信仰來聖化。

baltimore.zh: （城市）巴爾的摩，美國馬里蘭州的港口城市
ai: Baltimore is a port city in the state of Maryland.
巴爾的摩是美國馬里蘭州的一座港口城市。
We took a train from Washington to Baltimore.
我們從華盛頓搭火車去巴爾的摩。
The dancers moved in perfect synchronized steps.
舞者以完全同步的舞步移動。
Our phones and computers have synchronized calendars.
我們的手機和電腦有同步的行事曆。

achilles.zh: （人名）阿基里斯，希臘神話中的英雄
ai: In Greek myth, Achilles was a hero of the Trojan War.
在希臘神話中，阿基里斯是特洛伊戰爭的英雄。
The story says that Achilles was weak only at his heel.
傳說阿基里斯只有腳踝處是弱點。

disinformation.zh: 假訊息；蓄意散布的不實資訊
ai: The group spread disinformation to confuse voters.
這個團體散布假訊息來混淆選民。
Schools should teach students how to spot disinformation online.
學校應教學生如何辨識網路上的假訊息。
The old building was hideously ugly.
那棟老建築醜得嚇人。
The food was hideously expensive for what we got.
就我們吃到的東西而言，這頓飯貴得離譜。

rambunctious.zh: 吵鬧難管的；活潑好動的
ai: The rambunctious puppy knocked over the lamp.
那隻吵鬧好動的小狗撞倒了檯燈。
Her rambunctious students never sit still.
她那群活潑好動的學生從來坐不住。
The floodlit stadium looked beautiful at night.
燈火通明的體育場在夜晚看起來很美。
We watched a game on the floodlit field.
我們在被泛光燈照亮的球場上看了一場比賽。

whining.zh: 發牢騷；哀號（whine 的現在分詞）
ai: Stop whining and start cleaning your room.
不要再抱怨了，開始整理你的房間。
The dog was whining at the door to go out.
狗在門邊哀鳴著想出去。
The cafe has a warm and relaxing ambiance.
這家咖啡館的氣氛溫暖又放鬆。
Soft music and candles added to the ambiance of the dinner.
輕柔的音樂和蠟燭為晚餐增添了氣氛。
A deputation of workers met the manager yesterday.
一個工人代表團昨天與經理會面。
The village sent a deputation to ask the mayor for help.
村子派了一個代表團去請求市長協助。
